data.name: Set_Language_Desc
data.value: The language of Hotline's menus, settings and messages. AI answers follow the language you write in.

data.name: Set_CopilotKey_Desc
data.value: As Right Ctrl, Copilot+C is Ctrl+C and the key no longer opens Hotline (use the extra hotkey below, or the tray icon). Works on keyboards whose Copilot key sends Win+Shift+F23 (most do).

data.name: Set_Tap
data.value: Short press of the Copilot key

data.name: Set_Hold
data.value: Long press of the Copilot key

data.name: Set_Voice_Desc
data.value: Hold the Copilot key and talk; let go to stop (Esc cancels). Uses Windows speech recognition: allow the microphone and turn on Settings › Privacy & security › Speech › Online speech recognition. Turning it on sets the long press to voice; off sets it back to a new chat.

data.name: Set_Hotkey_Desc
data.value: Also opens Hotline, e.g. Ctrl+Alt+H. Leave empty for none.

data.name: Set_HideOnBlur_Desc
data.value: Pin the panel (📌) to keep it open temporarily.

data.name: Set_OnTop
data.value: Keep on top of other windows

data.name: Set_Backdrop_Desc
data.value: Acrylic is translucent; Solid is opaque.

data.name: Set_TextSize_Desc
data.value: Default follows Windows (Settings › Accessibility › Text size).

data.name: Set_Font_Desc
data.value: Any installed font, e.g. Cascadia Code. Empty = Segoe UI Variable.

data.name: Set_MinHeight_Desc
data.value: 0 = just the message bar; the panel grows upward as you type and chat.

data.name: Set_MaxHeight_Desc
data.value: How much of the screen it may grow to.

data.name: Set_NotifyDone
data.value: Notify when an answer finishes in the background

data.name: Set_NotifyDone_Desc
data.value: A Windows notification when an answer finishes while the panel is hidden or another app is in front. Click it to open the answer.

data.name: Set_Selection_Desc
data.value: When the key opens the panel, text selected in the app you came from is attached. Ctrl+C also works in apps that don't share their selection, but briefly uses the clipboard (restored afterwards).

data.name: Set_Stop_Desc
data.value: The key that stops an answer while it's being written (Enter never does; the Send button does too). A key alone (Esc) or a combo like Ctrl+. — when nothing is being answered, Esc hides the panel.

data.name: Set_Stop_Invalid
data.value: Not a valid shortcut (examples: Esc, Ctrl+., Ctrl+Shift+Backspace)

data.name: Set_Memory_Desc
data.value: Every chat sees memory.md in your .hotline folder ("/remember something" adds a line).

data.name: Set_MemoryTool_Desc
data.value: API connections can save a fact when you ask them to remember something.

data.name: Set_VoiceSend_Desc
data.value: With the Voice key action: send the message when you let go of the key.

data.name: Set_Ocr_Desc
data.value: Windows reads the text in images (offline) for models that can't see them.

data.name: Set_ImageSize_Desc
data.value: Attached and captured images are scaled to this longest edge.

data.name: Set_Logging_Desc
data.value: Writes extra diagnostics to the log.

data.name: Tools_Intro

data.name: Tools_NoneChecked

data.value: {0} — one file per connection; settings.json "chat.order" sets the dropdown order

data.value: System prompts are Markdown files. The default prompt is used by every connection that doesn't pick its own.

data.name: Agy_ReadFailed

data.name: Agy_Summary
data.value: agy rules: {0} allowed, {1} denied. Reading files in the working folder is allowed by default; shell commands need an allow rule.

data.name: Agy_AllowReadOnly_Tip
data.value: Adds rules like command(Get-ChildItem), command(git status) to agy's allow list, and denies Remove-Item, rm, git push...

data.name: Agy_AllowTitle
data.value: Allow read-only shell commands for agy?

data.name: Agy_AllowBody
Agy_ApproveAllBody
data.value: agy will run ANY shell command and edit or delete ANY file it decides to, without asking. A wrong answer or a malicious web page or file can make it do real damage. Only use this with a working folder you can afford to lose.

data.name: Agy_ApproveAll_Desc
data.value: Skips all of agy's permission checks (--dangerously-skip-permissions). Only in “use the program's own tools” mode.

data.name: Conn_ApiKey_Desc
data.value: Stored in Windows Credential Locker, not in settings.json.

data.name: Conn_ProgramPath_Desc
data.value: Leave empty to find it automatically.

data.name: Conn_ExtraArgs_Desc
data.value: Passed to the program as-is (space separated).

data.name: Conn_ToolUse_ApiDesc
data.value: Lets this AI use the tools from your MCP servers (Settings › Tools). Read-only tools run; anything else asks you in the panel first.

data.name: Conn_UseOwnTools
data.value: Use the program's own tools and permissions

data.name: Conn_ToolUse_CliDesc
data.value: Inherit lets the program run its tools (files, commands, web) under its own permission rules.

data.name: Conn_WorkingFolder_Desc
data.value: Where the program's tools act in Inherit mode.

data.name: Conn_RefusalFallback_Desc
data.value: If a safety check declines a request, the API re-serves it with a suitable model instead of stopping (Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, Opus 5, Sonnet 5.5).

data.name: Conn_Images_Desc
data.value: Off: screenshots are sent as their text (Settings › Chat › Screenshot text).

data.name: About_Intro
data.value: Hotline {0} — your AI on the Copilot key. Free and open source (Apache-2.0).

data.name: About_Support_Desc
data.value: Hotline is made by one person and has no ads or tracking. If it saves you time, a donation keeps it going.

data.name: About_SupportReminder_Desc
data.value: Shows "Enjoying Hotline?" once at the top of the panel, the next time you open it after an answer. It turns itself off after that; switch it back on here.

data.name: About_Project_Desc
data.value: Source code, releases, and the place to report problems or ask for features.

data.name: About_License_Desc
data.value: Apache-2.0, plus the licenses of the components Hotline uses.
